items.name: b12373
items.body:
<details open>

hexagon: add support for SSM_SCAN op (#31921)

* hexagon: add SSM_SCAN Op support

* hex-ssm-scan: fix multi-device spliting

* hex-ssm-scan: remove redundant checks and make kernel use host config

* hex-ssm-scan: remove direct ddr access

* hex-ssm-scan: remove DMA ordering

* hex-ops: update supported ops

* hex-ssm-scan: rewrite the dma pipeline to match other ops (dbl.buf, etc)

* hex-ssm-scan: remove all fallbacks, only dma/vtcm paths

* hex-ssm-scan: add kernel_type to kparams and remove redundant recomputes

* hex-ssm-scan: avoid stalls in the overall pipeline (dma flush between chunks)

* hex-ssm-scan: vectorize softplus

* hex-ssm-scan: optimize hvx loops

* hex-ssm-scan: add HMX support

* hex-ssm-scan: add support for GGML_HEXAGON_SSM_SELECT

* hex-ssm-scan: cleanup kernel names

* hex-ssm-scan: simplify mdev checks

* hex-mdev: improve mdev row-split solver

---------

Co-authored-by: Max Krasnyansky <maxk@qti.qualcomm.com>

</details>

hexagon: improve buffer allocations and mappings (mmap stacking) (#32144)

* hex-bufs: combine queue and fence buffers

* hex-bufs: use n_threads for queue sizing

* hex-mmap: optimize buffer stacking at the host to avoid iova fragmentation

* hex-mmap: add simply retry for spurios mmap failures

* hex-mmap: use eager mode for extended mmap retries
